title: OceanBench eddies insight payload
description: Payload for an insight of kind "eddies" (contracts.md §4). Mesoscale-eddy census comparing the challenger to one or more references, per lead day: matched eddies (with displacement), spurious (challenger-only) and missed (reference-only). Adapted from the branch-249 eddy-explorer payload, snake-cased to the rebuild conventions and stripped of viewer/XHR scaffolding.

kind.description: Discriminator matching the manifest entry kind.

schema_version.description: Version of this payload schema (first version of this contract lineage).

variable.description: Optional CF standard name the detection ran on (typically sea_surface_height_above_geoid).

bounds.description: Optional geographic bounds of the detection domain.

references.description: One census per reference the challenger is matched against (e.g. glorys, glo12).

parameters.description: Optional detection/matching parameters the census was produced with (km-based thresholds, contour filtering mode, emitting OceanBench version).

matches.description: Challenger eddies matched to a reference eddy, with the separating displacement.

spurious.description: Challenger eddies with no matching reference eddy.

missed.description: Reference eddies with no matching challenger eddy.

challenger.description: The challenger eddy of the matched pair.

reference.description: The reference eddy of the matched pair.

displacement_km.description: Great-circle distance in kilometres between the matched eddy centres.

id.description: Detection index, unique within its detection set.

latitude.description: Eddy-centre latitude in degrees north, rounded to 4 decimals.

longitude.description: Eddy-centre longitude in degrees east, rounded to 4 decimals.

contour_latitude.description: Latitudes of the point-limited closed contour polygon (4 decimals). Empty when no valid contour.

contour_longitude.description: Longitudes of the point-limited closed contour polygon (4 decimals), same length as contour_latitude.
